detailed_description:
The target video is a 3D CG animated remake of <Video 1> in a soft Pixar-style with rounded characters, fluffy fur, and natural daylight. The scene is set in <Subject 3>, the same outdoor terrace with wooden deck boards, green artificial turf, a modern glass building, bare winter trees, and pale overcast sky.
[Shot 1] The video opens with a static medium-wide shot, exactly matching <Video 1>'s opening frame. <Subject 1>, the chubby orange tabby cat in an oversized light-gray T-shirt and blue jeans, stands on the left; <Subject 2>, the calm Bengal tiger in an unbuttoned green short-sleeve shirt over a cream undershirt and brown knee-length shorts, stands on the right. Both hold an oversized round wok with both paws at chest level, pot bottom facing the camera. They lift one bent leg high in a synchronized crane stance, faces dead-serious, creating the same "earnestly silly" contrast as <Video 1>. The camera holds this pose for one beat, just like the source clip.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a medium tracking shot that matches <Video 1>'s forward-lunge sequence. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> drop into a low synchronized running lunge, paws gripping an imaginary giant wire whisk, charging toward the right side of frame with urgent, aggressive momentum. Their bodies lean forward, knees bent, tails trailing behind for balance. The camera tracks with them from a slight low angle, keeping both characters centered and maintaining the same comedic energy as <Video 1>.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the shot cuts to a wider shot as the choreography reaches its climax. <Subject 2>, the tiger, launches into a high flying kick toward frame right, leg fully extended, paws tight, expression still focused and serious. <Subject 1>, the cat, mirrors a defensive half-squat on the left, paws raised as if blocking, belly compressed, eyes squeezed with comic concentration. The camera remains at the same height and distance as <Video 1>, capturing the peak action with the glass building and bare trees behind them.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts back to a medium-wide shot for the landing and final pose. <Subject 2> lands the kick with a soft impact, bending one knee and sweeping one paw down; <Subject 1> straightens slowly from the half-squat, both still holding their serious expressions. The camera gently pulls back with small amplitude at slow speed, revealing the full terrace and holding the final synchronized beat until the clip ends at 00:10.000.

overall_soundscape:
Soft outdoor wind rustles through the bare trees behind the terrace; wooden deck boards creak faintly under the characters' padded paws; the oversized wok makes a low metallic thud when shifted; the wire whisk cuts the air with a light whoosh during the lunge; and a soft comedic landing impact accompanies the tiger's final kick.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, the same young Asian girl with chestnut-brown hair tied in a half-up ponytail secured by a soft pink satin bow, wearing a delicate silver star pendant necklace, appears in the exact position, outfit, and framing established by Picture 1 — a soft white T-shirt and matching A-line skirt both printed with small scattered cartoon bear motifs, both hands resting confidently on her hips, standing in front of a warm-toned café storefront with soft out-of-focus bokeh lights in the background. A light blue distressed denim jacket is resting on an unseen surface just outside the left edge of the frame at roughly waist height, and a small portion of its collar and shoulder is clearly visible at the left edge of the shot as the video begins, with no other person visible in the scene. The camera holds a steady medium shot framing her from the upper thighs to just above her head, with very small amplitude drift at slow speed to keep her centered. At 0.00 seconds she herself reaches her right hand out to the left side of the frame, grasps the collar of the denim jacket that is resting on that unseen surface, and lifts it upward in a smooth natural arc; meanwhile her own left hand comes off her hip to meet and grasp the opposite shoulder of the jacket, and she herself swings the jacket up and over her head in one continuous natural motion, her own arms finding the sleeves and sliding into them without any visual break or arm-clipping through the fabric, the jacket settling properly onto her shoulders in correct alignment. Around 4.00 seconds, after the jacket is fully on both arms, she speaks to the camera in a friendly, casual, conversational livestream-host voice (S1), directly introducing the clothing pattern: <d>[Chinese] 家人们，看咱家衣服的版型哈</d> she pauses briefly with a natural breath, then around 7.50 seconds she adds while patting the front panel of the now-worn jacket with her right palm to show the cut and fit: <d>[Chinese] 这个这个……啊，是吧</d> her lips and jaw move clearly in sync with each syllable, eyes bright and engaged with the camera, head tilting slightly as she speaks. By the 10.00-second mark her posture, outfit, hand position, and overall framing fully match Picture 2 — the light blue distressed denim jacket sits naturally on her shoulders with both arms properly inside the sleeves, no visual breaking, no fabric clipping, no hand-through-clothing artifacts, all seams correctly aligned.

overall_soundscape:
Only subtle, natural diegetic sound effects tied directly to visible on-screen actions, with no other voices, no off-screen chatter, no background music. The audio consists of: a soft rustle of denim fabric as the jacket is lifted and swung over her shoulders, a brief quiet whoosh of fabric movement as her arms slide into the sleeves, the gentle tap of her palm patting the front of the jacket to demonstrate the cut, and the close-miked natural sound of her own breathing and voice when she speaks. No other speakers, no background crowd noise, no music.

detailed_description:
首帧严格等同<picture 1>，(S1)面对镜头近景演唱，耳麦位置稳定，嘴唇与下颌按歌词逐字精准同步：她自然开口起唱，清晰完成辅音闭合、元音口型、停顿与换气，演唱<d>[Chinese]提起那宋老三，两口子卖大烟</d>，面部身份保持稳定，没有通用循环嘴型或延迟。0.00—1.00秒，她仍贴近镜头，右手从首帧的手势自然收回，肩颈随歌声轻微律动，眼神与镜头保持表演交流。约1.00秒后，她开始起身，重心上移，左肩带动身体微转，一手撩过长发；头发随转身动作明显扬起并向后甩开，舞台扫光从身后掠过。镜头同步缓慢Pull Out，从近景扩展到上半身，显露黑色露脐短西装与包臀超短裙，以及转身过程中形成的S曲线身姿。2.50—4.00秒，她完成由正面到背面的流畅转向，腰胯和肩线有节奏地延展，头发落回背部，表演动作不僵硬也不重复。4.00秒起，(S1)背对镜头继续演唱第二句内容，嘴型虽以侧后角度可见但仍保持音节级同步；她抬起右臂，伸出一根手指高于头顶，手腕随着乐句轻微摆动。镜头继续小幅拉远并保持舞台纵深，动态灯光扫过她的轮廓和发丝。5.50—7.00秒，她保持背影姿态向舞台深处缓慢离去，右手高举的手指逐渐降低到自然弧度，最后停在稍远的上半身背影，人物仍在灯光中保持清晰、精致的舞台表演质感。
